description: Returns the payoff of a buffered position across index returns from -40% to +30%, for a chosen buffer, cap and share of losses kept beyond the buffer. Same math as https://www.vistashares.com/buffer-etf-payoff-chart/.

buffer_pct.description: Buffer size, in percent. Accepts 0 to 100; default 10.

cap_pct.description: Cap on gains, in percent. Accepts 0 to 200; default 12.

loss_share_beyond_buffer.description: Share of losses beyond the buffer that the investor bears (1 = all, 0.5 = half). Accepts 0 to 1; default 1.

name: buffer_payoff_table
title: Buffer ETF payoff table
